title: Recover callback setup path

starting_state.worktree_at_start: dirty only in the pre-existing G64-046 candidate and host-test files; both were reviewed and retained

original_mips_findings: The function allocates a 0x38-byte frame and saves $s0-$s7 plus $ra. It conditionally calls func_80034B24_35724(handler, 0) when D_801C78D0_1C84D0 is non-null, then reloads D_801C7754_1C8354 and selects a window through D_80167C48_168848.
If the incoming stream word is not 0x8012, each 20-byte VmChoice receives x/y sums from window offsets 0x32/0x6E/0x50 and 0x34/0x74/0x54, plus previous/next cursor pointers.

For each record, the VM cursor advances to a resource operand and calls func_8003DE48_3EA48. It reloads D_801C7754_1C8354 after that callback and passes the live index plus the decoded pointer to func_8003EB34_3F734. It stores the subsequent script pointer, checks the next record's 0x8012 sentinel, and advances by eight bytes in the loop branch delay slot.

At exit it clears the first choice's previous link and the final choice's next link (count*20-8 from the choice base), calls func_8003E9E8_3F5E8, writes VM state 2, and returns the updated script cursor. The zero-record path also writes at choice_base-8, which the host fixture guards with a prefix word.

variant_accounting.historical_isolated_probe: decomp/results/vm_next_ten_batch2.json records an earlier 400-byte candidate with a 64-byte frame and no exact MIPS match; its 400 host scenarios were synthetic and it was not a full-unit proof.
variant_accounting.v2_stop_reason: The pointer-lifetime hypothesis did not produce the original saved-register layout or size. No second source change had a new falsifiable instruction prediction, so work stopped with GLOBAL_ASM retained.

trial.hypothesis: Keep choice, previous-cursor, and next-cursor pointers explicit across resource/text callbacks so IDO reuses the original saved-register roles and preserves the 348-byte layout.
trial.compile_command: The native artifact was inherited from the existing G64-046 research-v1 trial; its exact compile invocation was not retained in the scratch directory and was not replayed during closeout.
trial.target_direct_comparison: 45/87 words differ across the original 348-byte extent; first mismatch at +0x0C / 0x8003E6CC: original sw $s2,0x1C($sp), candidate sw $s5,0x28($sp).

linked_unit_first_mismatch.cause: The candidate E6C0 symbol is eight bytes too long, shifting the later callee and changing this forward-call relocation.

trial.symbol_layout: Candidate func_8003E6C0_3F2C0 is 0x164 bytes rather than 0x15C; the following func_8003E81C_3F41C moves from 0x8003E81C to 0x8003E824. Linked .text is 16 bytes larger than the original unit.

tests.focused_host_result: PASS 400/400 synthetic cases under ASan/UBSan; callback-taken/skipped, callback mutation of the active window index, empty/nonempty streams, single/multiple records, cursor return, choice links, and guard words were checked.
tests.target_rom_compare: Extracted the linked .text with mips-linux-gnu-objcopy and compared 87 big-endian words at .text+0x1720 against the pinned decompressed ROM at 0x3F2C0; first difference is +0x0C as recorded above.
tests.original_word_guard_result: PASS 4 tests; the guard includes E6C0's 87 original words and 12 instruction anchors.

post_rebase_application_validation.full_suite_result: No summary after about two minutes; stopped with SIGTERM (exit 143). The full suite result is unverified.

tests.full_rom_g2: NOT_RUN: target and complete candidate unit are nonmatching.
tests.inventory: NOT_RUN: no production ownership change was made.
